This agenda requires background knowledge on daily average water temperature data from Shasta Dam to Wilkins Slough.

## Background

(Background text goes here.)

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| fig-align: center
#| out-width: "80%"

year <- 2024

param <- "wtemp" # Options are: "wtemp" (Water Temperature F, Daily Average), "wtemp7dadm" (Water Temperature F, 7DADM), "flow" (Flow TCFS, Daily Average), or "turbidity" (Turbidity NTU, Daily Average)

grouping_type <- "data" # Options are "data" (Value), "targets" (Temperature Targets 56, 57, 58F), or "targets2017" (Temperature Targets 53, 55, 56F)

img_url <- paste0(
  "https://cbr.washington.edu/sacramento/data/php/rpt/basin_cond.php",
  "?sc=1",
  "&outputFormat=graph",
  "&basin=sacramento",
  "&year=", year,
  "&wparam=", param,
  "&gtype=", grouping_type,
  "&resolution=medium"
)
knitr::include_graphics(img_url)
```
